data.description: A neutral evil spellcaster can gain a beheaded as a familiar at 3rd level by taking the Improved Familiar feat. A beheaded familiar loses the mindless trait and has an Intelligence score appropriate for its master's level. A variant beheaded counts as an additional Hit Die toward the maximum Hit Dice of controlled undead.
